name: Peking Gourmet
description: Chinese restaurant in Pottstown. Cashew chicken, Moo Shu Pork, Young Chow Fried Rice, Happy Family. 799 State St. Call (610) 326-2332.

hero.headline: Peking Gourmet
hero.sub: Chinese cooking at 799 State St in Pottstown. Cashew chicken, Moo Shu Pork, Young Chow Fried Rice, Happy Family. Call (610) 326-2332. Monday through Thursday, 11 to 9.

offerings.heading: The dishes people <mark>already know.</mark>
items: Chicken with cashew nuts, Moo Shu Pork, and the rest of the board you came to order.
Young Chow Fried Rice and Happy Family when the table wants a shared plate, not a single entree.
Dine in or take out from 799 State St. Call (610) 326-2332 if you're already in the car.
Cashew chicken, Moo Shu Pork, Young Chow, Happy Family

story.heading: State Street, Pottstown
paragraphs: Peking Gourmet is a Chinese restaurant at 799 State St. The homepage still names the plates: cashew chicken, Moo Shu Pork, Young Chow Fried Rice, Happy Family.
Monday through Thursday the kitchen runs 11 to 9. Call (610) 326-2332. Confirm Friday and Saturday on the official site.

experience.heading: How the order should go.
items: Walk in on State Street, or call the number and pick up.
Name the dish. Cashew chicken and Moo Shu are already on the welcome list.
Happy Family and Young Chow cover the table that wants to share.

feature.heading: The regular Chinese board, cooked in Pottstown
feature.text: You don't need a tasting menu. You need cashew chicken, Moo Shu Pork, fried rice, and a table on State Street.

contact.heading: State Street is the <mark>door.</mark>
contact.sub: 799 State St, Pottstown. Confirm Friday, Saturday, and Sunday hours on the official site.
